title: Business Insider: The US Army wants to track ammo and supplies at war like you'd track an Amazon package | Rune Technologies News
summary: Rune Technologies collaborates with Shift5 to enhance logistics tracking.
body_markdown:
# Collaboration with Shift5


Rune Technologies has announced a new partnership with Shift5 to enhance logistics tracking capabilities for military operations. This collaboration aims to integrate advanced technology solutions that will allow for real-time tracking of supplies and equipment.


> "Our partnership with Shift5 will revolutionize how the military manages its logistics," stated a Rune Technologies representative.


This initiative is expected to significantly improve the efficiency of supply chain operations.
